## Checklist

- [ ] Generated palette outputs are not committed (they are listed in `.gitignore`).
- [ ] User-facing docs under `docs/` are updated when behaviour changes.
- [ ] Visual changes include before/after screenshots.
- [ ] Commits contain no secrets, personal data, or unrelated changes.
